Title: IPluginPackageService Contract
Summary: Contract for querying and downloading packages from plugin distribution servers.
Content:
# IPluginPackageService Contract

## Namespace
`Cyrena.Extensa.Contracts`

## Purpose
Queries packages from and downloads packages to plugin distribution servers.

## Methods

### GetPackagesAsync
```csharp
Task<IReadOnlyList<Package>> GetPackagesAsync(
    PluginServer server,
    string applicationId,
    PackageQueryOptions? options = null,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```
Lists all packages from a specific server and application.
- `server`: Target plugin server
- `applicationId`: Application identifier on the server
- `options`: Optional filter (os, arch)

### GetPackageAsync
```csharp
Task<Package?> GetPackageAsync(
    PluginServer server,
    string applicationId,
    string packageId,
    PackageQueryOptions? options = null,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```
Gets a specific package by ID, or null if not found.

### DownloadPackageAsync
```csharp
Task<PackageDownloadResult> DownloadPackageAsync(
    PluginServer server,
    string applicationId,
    string packageId,
    PackageQueryOptions? options = null,
    IProgress<double>? progress = null,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```
Downloads a package as a stream with progress reporting.
- `options.Version`: Optional specific version to download
- `progress`: Reports download progress (0.0 to 1.0)

### GetPackageIconAsync
```csharp
Task<byte[]?> GetPackageIconAsync(
    PluginServer server,
    string applicationId,
    string packageId,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```
Gets the package icon as raw bytes, or null if not available.

### SearchPackagesAsync
```csharp
Task<IReadOnlyList<PackageSearchResult>> SearchPackagesAsync(
    string applicationId,
    PackageQueryOptions? options = null,
    CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```
Searches packages across all enabled servers concurrently.

## Result Types

### PackageDownloadResult
```csharp
public class PackageDownloadResult
{
    public required Stream Stream { get; init; }
    public required string FileName { get; init; }
    public long ContentLength { get; init; }
    public string? ContentHash { get; init; }
    public string? Version { get; init; }
}
```

### PackageSearchResult
```csharp
public class PackageSearchResult
{
    public required Package Package { get; init; }
    public required PluginServer Server { get; init; }
}
```
